product_metadata.title: Battery Alarm Clock, 4.5" LCD Display Digital Clock for Kids, Backlight, Night Light, Date and Indoor Temperature, Table Clocks for Bedrooms, Simple Small Alarm Clock (Black)
description: Home/Desk Bedroom Digital Alarm Clock - Battery Digital Clock: battery powered digital clock, no USB cable. Requires 3 AAA 1.5V batteries (not included in supply) - Large LCD screen, energy efficient, clear bold digital display, easy to read. - Easy to operate, convertible to ° F and ° C, 12 h and 24 h. - Mini Small digital clock, palm-sized, can be stored in a bag when traveling. - Children's Girl Alarm Clock :4 colors optional. Girl's Pink clock; Blue/black/white Alarm clock suitable for children and teens - Clock beeps at new moon for 60 seconds when alarm clock is activated - Smart alarm light with built-in light sensor,LCD backlight automatically turns on when room or environment gets dark. Don't worry, it won't disturb your sleep.  Packing list · 1* Battery digital clock ·
